subject: Social-listening + response automation for your agency
message: Hi Martin, saw your post in r/PakStartups about finding and reaching the thousands of people asking for recommendations aligned with your products - we built a tool that does exactly this: social listening across Reddit, LinkedIn, Facebook, X and Instagram, buying-intent scoring, and automated response drafts that stay human-in-the-loop. Happy to share a 5-minute demo. Would a quick call work this week?
price_proposal: $150 setup + $75/mo maintenance (market rate for agency-grade social-listening automation)
cta: If this direction looks good, shall we discuss the details?
